title: A Message Giving Directions
instructions: Write your own first draft, submit it, and use feedback to revise it.
prompt: Write 100–140 words to a real or imagined friend who wants to visit a place in town. Explain where to start, two clear directions, one polite question to ask for help, and one safety choice with a reason. Compare two possible routes, state your plan with going to, and distinguish a safety rule from something that is not necessary.
